longForm.overview:
🤨 is the emoji of face-with-raised-eyebrow-coded skeptic - a face with a single raised eyebrow, indicating skepticism or suspicion, the iconography of 'really?,' suspicion-coded side-eye, and 'face with raised eyebrow for you' register. Where 🧐 reads as monocled-coded scrutinize and 😏 reads as smirking-coded knowing, 🤨 captures the moment when the sender wants to communicate suspicion-coded intimacy - a 'face with raised eyebrow for you 🤨' partner moment or a 'really? 🤨' side-eye reveal. The face with raised eyebrow cue borrows from the universal skeptic tradition and the modern 'really?' aesthetic, which is exactly why the emoji reads as suspicion-coded rather than literal face with raised eyebrow.

In real-world usage 🤨 lives in the spaces where the sender wants to communicate side-eye-coded comfort. A partner sends it on a 'face with raised eyebrow for you 🤨' check-in. A friend sends it on a 'really? 🤨' reveal. A coworker sends it on a 'face with raised eyebrow mode 🤨' work message. The face with raised eyebrow cue is what makes the emoji feel suspicion-coded - it is not just 'face with raised eyebrow,' it is 'face-with-raised-eyebrow-coded really.'

What separates 🤨 from the rest of the skeptical-emoji family is the really register. The emoji is not saying 'monocled scrutinize' (🧐), 'smirking knowing' (😏), or 'unamused-coded dry' (😒). It is saying 'face-with-raised-eyebrow-coded skeptic,' which carries a specific suspicion-coded charm.
